charts.question: Abandonment at identical purchased staffing hours
charts.supported_finding: The three policies receive the same two-hour flexible reserve.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Historical outcomes describe observed calls. Staffing schedules, patience past the censoring point, operator flexibility and policy-dependent waits are simulated. The five-hour morning replay begins with an empty queue.
